create_chirp_signal: create a linear chirp signal from frequency f0 to f1 over duration T at sampling rate fs
create_hanning_window: create a Hanning window array of length N for signal processing
create_hamming_window: create a Hamming window array of length N for signal processing
test_chirp_function: test the chirp function by generating a signal between 100Hz and 1000Hz over 1 second
test_window_function: test the window function by generating a Hanning window of length 1024
